children: on Wednesday, and although Stifel was impressed with the company's strategy, they found the 2030 outlook potentially below expectations, prompting the firm to maintain its Hold rating and reduce its price target to $75 from $90.

"We came away encouraged on strategy, specifically an end-to-end AI data center franchise taking content from ~$15K to ~$115K per rack by CY30, the Embedded Power Platform, physical AI at a $6bn TAM, and auto projected to outgrow SAAR by high single digits," Stifel analysts said in an investor note. "That said, the CY30 model of +12-14% revenue CAR, 53% GM and 38% OM is potentially below expectations (see changes vs. the prior LT model below). The NT to MT GM path also remains unclear, weighing on EPS power versus analog peers."
onsemi shares edged up 2% during market trading on Wednesday.
, onsemi CEO Hassane El-Khoury explained power remains the last bottleneck to expanding the AI data center buildout.

"We've seen the first limitation with compute," he said. "We've lived through it, and we've unlocked it with advancements in technology and capacity. And we've also seen it with memory. We're actually—I would argue we're living through it with memory with advancements that are going to break through."

"But, to solve the power, it is not a new product," he added. "It is not a new technology. It is not a new system. It is a layering effect of a value stack that has to work across top to bottom to deliver on that power density with the efficiency that is required to scale, starting with the foundation of technology into a deployment of products that extract the capabilities of these technologies and together create these solutions that are going to solve these customer problems and deliver the systems with the value and scale that will solve those generational problems."

"Management pointed to 800V and higher stepping down to 6V or less in AI data centers; 13.8kV to 34.5kV for industrial solid-state transformers; and 400V to 900V+ in xEV," Stifel noted. "ON sized its opportunity at a $213bn TAM, of which $118bn, or more than half, sits in power."

title: onsemi's 2030 outlook falls short; Stifel lowers target
